source: src/cards/cards-data.js（唯一卡面事实源；中文卡文优先 textZh）

cards.name: .45 Thompson
cards.text:
Uses (5 ammo).
Ammo spent from .45 Thompson is placed in your resource pool, as resources.
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
cards.textZh:
使用(5子弹)。
从.45汤姆逊冲锋枪上花费的子弹放入你的资源池，作为资源。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。

cards.name: .45 Thompson
cards.text:
Uses (5 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by at least X, you may spend 1 ammo to deal this attack's damage to another enemy at your location, where X is that enemy's fight value.
cards.textZh:
使用(5子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少X点，你可以花费1子弹以对你所在地点的另一个敌人造成本次攻击的伤害，其中X为该敌人的攻击值。

cards.name: Scroll of Secrets
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Scroll of Secrets and spend 1 secret: Look at the bottom 3 cards of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. You may discard 1 of those cards. You may add 1 of those cards to its owner's hand. Place the rest of those cards on either the top or bottom of their deck, in any order.
cards.textZh:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置秘密卷轴并花费1秘密：查看任意一位调查员的牌库底或遭遇牌库底3张卡牌。你可以弃掉其中1张。你可以将其中1张加入其所有者手牌。将其中剩余的卡牌以任意顺序放到该牌库顶或牌库底。

cards.name: Scroll of Secrets
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Scroll of Secrets and spend 1 secret: Look at the top or bottom card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Then, either discard that card, add it to its owner's hand, place it on the bottom of its deck, or place it on top of its deck.
cards.textZh:
使用(4秘密)。
[action]横置秘密卷轴并花费1秘密：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或牌库底1张卡牌，或遭遇牌库顶或牌库底1张卡牌。然后，弃掉该卡牌、将其加入其所有者手牌，或将其放到该牌库底或者牌库顶。

cards.name: Tennessee Sour Mash
cards.text:
Fast. Uses (2 supplies).
[fast] Exhaust Tennessee Sour Mash and spend 1 supply: You get +3 [willpower] for a skill test on a treachery card.
[action] Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
cards.textZh:
快速。使用(2补给)。
[free]横置田纳西酸麦芽威士忌并花费1补给：你在诡计卡牌的一次技能检定中得到+3[willpower]。
[action]弃掉田纳西酸麦芽威士忌：攻击。本次攻击你得到+3[combat]并造成+1伤害。

cards.name: Tennessee Sour Mash
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Exhaust Tennessee Sour Mash and spend 1 supply: You get +2 [willpower] for a skill test on a treachery card.
[action] Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If this attack succeeds against a non-[[Elite]] enemy, automatically evade it.
cards.textZh:
快速。使用(3补给)。
[free]横置田纳西酸麦芽威士忌并花费1补给：你在诡计卡牌的一次技能检定中得到+2[willpower]。
[action]弃掉田纳西酸麦芽威士忌：攻击。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]。如果本次攻击对一个非[[精英]]敌人检定成功，自动躲避该敌人。

cards.name: Enchanted Blade
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to empower the blade, dealing +1 damage for this attack. If the blade is empowered and this attack defeats an enemy, draw 1 card and heal 1 horror.
cards.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能来为剑附魔，使本次攻击造成+1伤害。如果剑已附魔且本次攻击击败了敌人，抽取1张卡牌并治愈1点恐惧。

cards.name: Enchanted Blade
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to use this ability, you may spend up to 2 charges to empower the blade (for each charge spent in this way, you get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack).
cards.textZh:
使用(4充能)。
[action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。作为使用本能力的额外费用，你可以花费最多2充能来为剑附魔(每以此方式花费1充能，本次攻击你得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害)。

cards.name: Grisly Totem
cards.text: [reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice. If that skill test is successful, the performing investigator draws 1 card.
cards.textZh: [reaction]在你将卡牌投入技能检定后，横置恐怖图腾：你选择该卡牌已有的任意一个技能图标，该卡牌额外获得该图标。如果该次技能检定成功，执行检定的调查员抽取1张卡牌。

cards.name: Grisly Totem
cards.text: [reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice. If that skill test fails, return that card to your hand.
cards.textZh: [reaction]在你将卡牌投入技能检定后，横置恐怖图腾：你选择该卡牌已有的任意一个技能图标，该卡牌额外获得该图标。如果该次技能检定失败，将该卡牌返回你手牌。

cards.name: The Council's Coffer
cards.text:
Uses (1 [per_investigator] locks). If there are no locks on The Council's Coffer, each investigator searches his or her deck or discard pile for any card and immediately plays it at no cost. Exile The Council's Coffer. (Max once per campaign.)
[action] [action]: Test any skill (5). If you succeed, remove 1 lock. Any investigator at your location may activate this ability.
Card design by The Council at Arkham Nights 2017.
cards.textZh:
使用(1[per_investigator]锁头)。如果委员会的保险箱上没有锁头，每位调查员查找自己的牌库或弃牌堆，找出任意一张卡牌并立即将其免费打出。放逐委员会的保险箱。(每个剧本最多一次。)
[action][action]：检定任意一项技能(5)。如果你检定成功，移除1锁头。你所在地点的任何调查员均可以激活本能力。
卡牌设计于阿卡姆之夜2017理事会。

cards.name: Warning Shot
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Warning Shot, spend 1 ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
Move all non-[[Elite]] enemies at your location to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.textZh:
作为打出鸣枪示警的额外费用，花费你控制的一张[[枪械]]支援的1子弹。
将你所在地点的所有非[[精英]]敌人移动到一个连接地点。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

cards.name: Telescopic Sight
cards.text:
Fast. Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control that takes up two hand slots. Attached asset cannot be used to attack enemies engaged with you.
[reaction] When you perform a Fight action using attached asset, if you are engaged with no enemies, exhaust Telecopic Sight: This attack can target a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack.
cards.textZh:
快速。附属到你控制的一张占用2个手部槽位的[[枪械]]支援。所附属支援不能用于攻击与你交战的敌人。
[reaction]在你用所附属支援执行攻击行动时，如果你没有与任何敌人交战，横置瞄准镜：本次攻击能够以一个连接地点上的一个非[[精英]]敌人作为对象。本次攻击忽略冷漠和反击关键词。

cards.name: Knowledge is Power
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset you control, or reveal a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your hand. Resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost, if any). Then, if that asset was in your hand, you may discard it to draw 1 card.
cards.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
选择一张你控制的[[书籍]]或[[法术]]支援，或揭示你手牌中的一张[[书籍]]或[[法术]]支援。结算该支援上的一个[action]或[free]能力，忽略所有费用(包括其[action]费用，如有)。然后，如果该支援是从你手牌中揭示的，你可以弃掉它来抽取1张卡牌。

cards.name: Esoteric Atlas
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Esoteric Atlas: Choose a revealed location that is exactly 2 connections away from your location. Move to that location.
cards.textZh:
使用(4秘密)。
[action]花费1秘密并横置绝密地图集：选择一个与你所在地点之间的连接次数正好为2的已揭示地点。移动到该地点。

cards.name: Investments
cards.text:
Uses (0 supplies). Limit 10 supplies on Investments.
[fast] Exhaust Investments: Place 1 supply on it.
[action] Exhaust and discard Investments: Move all supplies from it to your resource pool, as resources.
cards.textZh:
使用(0补给)。投资上仅限10补给。
[free]横置投资：在上面放置1补给。
[action]横置并弃掉投资：将本卡牌上所有补给移动到你的资源池，作为资源。

cards.name: Decoy
cards.text:
Evade. Automatically evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
[reaction] When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "a non-[[Elite]] enemy" to "up to 2 non-[[Elite]] enemies."
[reaction] When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."
cards.textZh:
恩惠，服务
躲避。自动躲避你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。
[reaction]在你打出诱敌时，提升其费用2点：“一个非[[精英]]敌人”变为“最多2个非[[精英]]敌人”。
[reaction]在你打出诱敌时，提升其费用2点：“你所在地点”变为“与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的地点”。

cards.name: De Vermis Mysteriis
cards.text: [action] Exhaust De Vermis Mysteriis and place 1 doom on it: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile, reducing its resource cost by 1. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.
cards.textZh: [action]横置蠕虫的秘密并在其上放置1个毁灭标记：从你的弃牌堆打出一张[[法术]]或[[洞察]]事件，其资源费用减少1点。该事件结算后，将其从游戏中移除。

cards.name: Guiding Spirit
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Guiding Spirit before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
Forced - When Guiding Spirit is defeated by horror: Exile it.
cards.textZh:
你得到+1[intellect]
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给指路鬼魂。
强制 - 在指路鬼魂因为恐惧而被击败时：将其放逐。

cards.name: Fortune or Fate
cards.text:
Fast. Play when doom would be placed on any scenario card.
Max 1 per game.
Cancel 1 doom just placed on that card. Exile Fortune or Fate.
cards.textZh:
快速。在毁灭标记将要放到任意冒险卡牌上时打出。
每场游戏最多1张。
取消将要放到该卡牌上的1个毁灭标记。放逐幸运或是注定。

cards.name: Mk 1 Grenades
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Mk 1 Grenades has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy and each other investigator at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy).
cards.textZh:
使用(3补给)。如果MK1手榴弹没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]花费1补给：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果本次攻击成功，本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为对受攻击敌人所在地点的每个敌人和每位其他调查员造成2点伤害(所有额外伤害只对被攻击敌人造成)。

cards.name: Agency Backup
cards.text:
Agency Backup may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Agency Backup and deal 1 damage to it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Agency Backup and deal 1 horror to it: Discover 1 clue at your location.
cards.textZh:
你所在地点其他调查员受到的伤害和/或恐惧，可以分配给特工支援。
[free]横置特工支援并对其造成1点伤害：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。
[free]横置特工支援并对其造成1点恐惧：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
